name: combo-chart
title: Combo chart
description: A React combo chart with bars and lines on one shared y-axis: a daily count with its rolling average, or parts against a target. No dual axis. Accessible.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Combo chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/combo-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { ComboChart, ComboTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/combo-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
